load_model: load a TransformerLensTransparentLlm model by name onto a specified device with Streamlit caching
run_model: run inference on a single sentence through a loaded TransparentLlm model
get_contribution_graph: build a NetworkX contribution graph for a model with a given threshold value
load_dataset: load sentences from a text file into a list of strings
possible_devices: check which compute devices are available and return a list of gpu or cpu
